ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce remote service-push ransomware: PsExec/SMB deployment + Volume Shadow Copy wipe before mass encryption
ucs.description: Hunts DragonForce's hallmark hands-on-keyboard ransomware deployment — pushing the encryptor to hosts over SMB admin shares via a remotely-created service (PsExec-style), then destroying Volume Shadow Copies and backup catalogs immediately before T1486 encryption. DragonForce (RaaS, MY-origin, formerly the DragonForce Malaysia hacktivist crew; its affiliate program is heavily abused by Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest / 'Scattered LAPSUS$ Hunters') uses a LockBit-3.0/Conti-derived builder that wipes recovery before encrypting.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval shadow_wipe=if(match(process,"(?i)(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete|win32_shadowcopy.*delete|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|delete\s+catalog\s+-quiet|Get-WmiObject\s+Win32_Shadowcopy)"),1,0)
| where shadow_wipe=1
| eval remote_svc=if(match(parent_process_name,"(?i)(psexesvc|services)\.exe"),1,0)
| join type=left dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count as svc_binary_writes from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\ADMIN$\\*","*\\C$\\*","*\\Windows\\PSEXESVC.exe") OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("PSEXESVC.exe","*.exe")) by Filesystem.dest]
| where remote_svc=1 OR svc_binary_writes>0
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process remote_svc svc_binary_writes count
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ShadowWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog -quiet","Win32_Shadowcopy")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              WipeParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              WipeCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
// pair the recovery-wipe with a remotely-installed service binary (PsExec tradecraft) on the same host
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("services.exe","psexesvc.exe")
   or InitiatingProcessParentFileName =~ "psexesvc.exe"
| where ProcessIntegrityLevel in ("System","High")
| project SvcTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, SvcUser = AccountName,
          SvcParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          SvcImage = FolderPath, SvcCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| join kind=inner ShadowWipe on DeviceName
| where Timestamp between (SvcTime - 30m .. SvcTime + 30m)
| project SvcTime, WipeTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          SvcParent, SvcImage, SvcCmd, WipeParent, WipeCmd
| order by SvcTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ShadowWipe = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog -quiet","Win32_Shadowcopy")
    | project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName = TargetUserName,
              WipeParent = ParentProcessName, WipeCmd = CommandLine;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("services.exe","PSEXESVC.exe")
| project SvcTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcUser = TargetUserName,
          SvcParent = ParentProcessName, SvcImage = NewProcessName, SvcCmd = CommandLine
| join kind=inner ShadowWipe on Computer
| where Timestamp between (SvcTime - 30m .. SvcTime + 30m)
| project SvcTime, WipeTime = Timestamp, Computer, AccountName,
          SvcParent, SvcImage, SvcCmd, WipeParent, WipeCmd
| order by SvcTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volume Shadow Copy and Backup Catalog Destruction (DragonForce ransomware pre-encryption)
id: 9a1c4e22-7d3b-4f1a-b6c8-2f0e5a9d1b44
status: experimental
description: Detects deletion of Volume Shadow Copies / backup catalogs and disabling of Windows recovery, the recovery-inhibition step DragonForce performs immediately before T1486 encryption.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\vssadmin.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\bcdedit.exe'
      - '\wbadmin.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete shadows'
      - 'shadowcopy delete'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
      - 'delete catalog -quiet'
      - 'Win32_Shadowcopy'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup software performing catalog rotation
  - Administrative disk maintenance scripts
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1490
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE)) AND (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"delete catalog -quiet"*)) AND -@TargetUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(delete\\s+shadows|shadowcopy\\s+delete|recoveryenabled\\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|delete\\s+catalog\\s+-quiet|Win32_Shadowcopy)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ParentBaseFileName=/(services|psexesvc)\.exe/i OR ParentBaseFileName=*
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=([count(), collect([CommandLine]), min(_time, as=firstSeen)]))

ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce LSASS credential harvest → RDP/SMB lateral spread (intrusion staging)
ucs.description: Hunts the DragonForce intrusion chain that precedes encryption: dumping LSASS for domain credentials (T1003.001) via comsvcs.exe MiniDump, procdump, or rundll32, followed by interactive RDP / SMB admin-share authentication from the same compromised host into multiple internal systems. This maps DragonForce's documented reliance on valid-account reuse and RDP/SMB lateral movement after harvesting creds from a foothold gained via external-remote-service / public-app exploitation.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("comsvcs.dll","rundll32.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","taskmgr.exe","powershell.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where (match(process,"(?i)comsvcs\.dll.*MiniDump") OR match(process,"(?i)MiniDump\s+\d+") OR match(process,"(?i)procdump.*-ma\s+lsass") OR match(process,"(?i)-accepteula.*lsass") OR match(process,"(?i)Out-Minidump|lsass\.dmp"))
| rename dest as src
| join type=inner src [| tstats summariesonly=true dc(Authentication.dest) as targets values(Authentication.dest) as dest_hosts from datamodel=Authentication where (Authentication.action=success AND Authentication.app IN ("win:remote","smb","ntlm","kerberos")) by Authentication.src Authentication.user | rename Authentication.src as src Authentication.user as auth_user | where targets>=3]
| table firstTime lastTime src user auth_user process_name process targets dest_hosts
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LateralThreshold = 3;  // 3+ distinct internal targets from the dumping host = fan-out
let CredDump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDump")
         or (FileName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("lsass.dmp","Out-Minidump") )
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              DumpImage = FolderPath, DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
CredDump
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | where LogonType in ("RemoteInteractive","Network")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize Targets = dcount(RemoteDeviceName),
                TargetHosts = make_set(RemoteDeviceName, 50),
                FirstLateral = min(Timestamp)
      by SourceDevice = DeviceName, AccountName
    | where Targets >= LateralThreshold
) on $left.DeviceName == $right.SourceDevice
| where FirstLateral between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 6h)
| project DumpTime, FirstLateral, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DumpImage, DumpCmd, Targets, TargetHosts
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LateralThreshold = 3;
let CredDump = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "rundll32.exe" and CommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and CommandLine has "MiniDump")
         or (NewProcessName has_any ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe") and CommandLine has "lsass")
         or (CommandLine has_any ("lsass.dmp","Out-Minidump"))
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName = TargetUserName,
              DumpImage = NewProcessName, DumpCmd = CommandLine;
CredDump
| join kind=inner (
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4624
    | where LogonType in (3, 10)   // 3 = Network/SMB, 10 = RemoteInteractive/RDP
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | summarize Targets = dcount(Computer),
                TargetHosts = make_set(Computer, 50),
                FirstLateral = min(TimeGenerated)
      by AccountName = TargetUserName, IpAddress
    | where Targets >= LateralThreshold
) on AccountName
| where FirstLateral between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 6h)
| project DumpTime, FirstLateral, Computer, AccountName,
          DumpImage, DumpCmd, SourceIp = IpAddress, Targets, TargetHosts
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LSASS Memory Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump or ProcDump (DragonForce credential harvest)
id: 3e7b1f08-4c2d-49aa-9d5e-8a1c6f2b0e91
status: experimental
description: Detects LSASS process memory dumping via comsvcs.dll MiniDump export, ProcDump, or PowerShell Out-Minidump, the T1003.001 step DragonForce uses to harvest domain credentials before RDP/SMB lateral movement.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_comsvcs:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'comsvcs.dll'
      - 'MiniDump'
  selection_procdump:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\procdump.exe'
      - '\procdump64.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'lsass'
  selection_ps:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Out-Minidump'
      - 'lsass.dmp'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_comsvcs or selection_procdump or selection_ps) and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate crash-dump / EDR memory-forensics tooling
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ((@CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll* OR *COMSVCS.DLL*) AND @CommandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *minidump*)) OR (@Image:(*\\procdump.exe OR *\\procdump64.exe OR *\\ProcDump.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*lsass* OR *LSASS*)) OR @CommandLine:(*Out-Minidump* OR *lsass.dmp* OR *LSASS.DMP*)) AND -@TargetUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (regex("(?i)comsvcs\\.dll.*MiniDump", field=CommandLine) OR (ImageFileName=/\\procdump(64)?\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)lsass", field=CommandLine)) OR regex("(?i)(Out-Minidump|lsass\\.dmp)", field=CommandLine))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=/(10|3)/ | groupBy([UserName], function=count(field=ComputerName, distinct=true, as=targets)) | targets>=3}, field=UserName, include=[targets])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=([count(), collect([CommandLine, targets]), min(_time, as=firstSeen)]))
ucs.rationale: DragonForce intrusions (and the Scattered Spider affiliates running its RaaS) characteristically pivot from an exploited public-app / external-remote-service foothold to LSASS credential theft, then reuse harvested valid accounts to fan out over RDP and SMB admin shares ahead of encryption.
